name: Avant-Garde Sculptural

intent_defaults.description: An experimental design direction exploring asymmetry, volume, structural silhouettes and unexpected component relationships.
intent_defaults.silhouette: Asymmetric, sculptural or deliberately unconventional; all dimensions remain editable.

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Experimental aesthetics do not guarantee movement, comfort or manufacturability.
The design must still pass geometric, seam, material and construction checks before production.
